metadata.limit: One native read-only explanation, no timing/token metrics or live qualification.

expectations.text: Distinguishes MCP protocol revisions from released package 2.1.3 and unpublished candidate 2.2.0.
expectations.evidence: Protocol revisions 2025-11-25 and 2026-07-28, released sendmux-mcp2.1.3 historical catalogue, unpublished candidate2.2.0.

expectations.text: States released 54 tools (26/22/6) and candidate 150 names (92/46/12), comprising 75 tools (46/23/6) and their aliases.
expectations.evidence: Table gives 54 (26/22/6),150 (92/46/12),75 (46/23/6); each unprefixed tool has a qubrics_ alias.

expectations.text: Distinguishes the catalogue from credential-visible subsets and avoids client compatibility certification.
expectations.evidence: Selected server surfaces and OAuth grants determine the subset; configurations are documented examples, not client certification.

expectations.text: Keeps the legacy hosted URL primary, names the candidate canonical resource, and preserves exact resource/audience isolation.
expectations.evidence: The guide keeps https://mcp.sendmux.ai/mcp primary; https://mcp.qubrics.com/mcp is candidate canonical. Request, grant and token audience must bind exactly.

expectations.text: Does not execute commands, inspect live state, access credentials, send messages or certify publication.
expectations.evidence: No skill commands executed, credentials accessed, live state checked or publication certified.
